# Generate XUnit Tests for Converted MS Access Form

> **FPSAPPS** is the overall system. This prompt generates XUnit unit tests for code produced by the
> `convert-access-form-to-DotNet.prompt.md` prompt. **Run the conversion first** — this prompt
> will stop immediately if the conversion artefact is missing.
>
> | Placeholder | Description | Example |
> |---|---|---|
> | `[App]` | App module (PascalCase) | `FPS`, `PACT`, `Costbook`, `PIMS` |
> | `[FormName]` | Form name (PascalCase, no spaces) | `MaintWGStaff`, `StaffJob` |
> | `[Entity]` | Primary entity derived from the Build artefact | `WgEmployee` |
> | `[KeyType]` | Primary key C# type | `int`, `string`, `Guid` |

---

## Quick Start

**Step 1** — Open VS Code (not Visual Studio) with the FPSAPPS workspace folder open, then open the **GitHub Copilot Chat** panel (`Ctrl+Alt+I`).

**Step 2** — Make sure you are in **Agent** mode.

**Step 3** — Confirm that the conversion has already been run:

| Required artefact | Location |
|---|---|
| Build verification report | `zPostRunValidationArtefacts/[App]-[FormName]-Build.md` |

**Step 4** — Type the slash command:

| What you want to test | Command to type |
|---|---|
| FPS — MaintWGStaff tests | `/Generate XUnit Tests for Converted Form FPS MaintWGStaff` |
| FPS — StaffJob tests | `/Generate XUnit Tests for Converted Form FPS StaffJob` |
| PACT — MonthlyOutputLog tests | `/Generate XUnit Tests for Converted Form PACT MonthlyOutputLog` |

Valid app names (PascalCase): **`FPS`  `PACT`  `Costbook`  `PIMS`**

---

## Concurrency Lock (FIRST THING TO DO — before any other step)

The agent uses a single lock file `zPostRunValidationArtefacts/.utagent-lock` to prevent two runs
from executing simultaneously in the same workspace folder.

### Lock file format

```
agent-name: Generate XUnit Tests for Converted Form
form-name: <[App] [FormName] — as supplied in the prompt argument>
current-phase: <name of the phase currently executing>
started: <ACTUAL machine timestamp — ISO-8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss>

| Phase                   | Start               | Status      | End                 | Reason                          |
|-------------------------|---------------------|-------------|---------------------|---------------------------------|
| <<current phase>>       | <ACTUAL timestamp>  | IN-PROGRESS |                     |                                 |
```

> **Timestamps must be real.** Always run `Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss'` to obtain the
> current machine time. **Never** hardcode or reuse example timestamps.
> **Reason** — leave blank for `IN-PROGRESS` and `COMPLETED`; populate with a short failure description when `Status = FAILED`.

### On startup — check for an existing lock

1. Use `file_search` to check whether `zPostRunValidationArtefacts/.utagent-lock` exists.
2. **If the file exists**, read it and stop immediately:

   ```
   ❌ A session is already running.
   Agent:         <agent-name value>
   Form:          <form-name value>
   Current phase: <current-phase value>
   Started at:    <started value>
   Please wait for that session to complete, or archive the stale lock by renaming
   zPostRunValidationArtefacts/.utagent-lock
   to
   zPostRunValidationArtefacts/utagentrun_<yyyyMMdd_HHmmss>.log
   ```

3. **If the file does not exist**, create `zPostRunValidationArtefacts/.utagent-lock` with the format
   above (first phase row as `IN-PROGRESS`) and proceed.

### During execution

- **Phase start:** update `current-phase` in the header; add a row with `IN-PROGRESS` and actual start timestamp.
- **Phase end (success):** update that row with `COMPLETED` and actual end timestamp.
- **Error:** update the row with `FAILED`, actual end timestamp, and a short failure reason in the Reason column, then stop.

### On completion (or error) — archive the lock

```powershell
Rename-Item `
  -Path  "zPostRunValidationArtefacts/.utagent-lock" `
  -NewName "utagentrun_$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss').log"
```

## Phase 0 — Prerequisites Check

> 📄 Follow [06 — XUnit Test Generation](./../instructions/06-xunit-test-generation.instructions.md) **Section 0** for the full prerequisites check.

1. Run `Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss'` and create the lock file.
2. Search for `zPostRunValidationArtefacts/[App]-[FormName]-Build.md`.
   - **Not found** → update lock row to `FAILED`, archive the lock, and stop with the error message from Section 0.
3. Read `[App]-[FormName]-Build.md` in full — extract the **Files Created** table to get the authoritative list of source files.
4. If `[App]-[FormName]-DataGrid.md` exists, read it too (Grid Operations Profile affects which controller actions exist).

---

## Phase 1 — Source & Reference Discovery

> 📄 Follow [06 — XUnit Test Generation](./../instructions/06-xunit-test-generation.instructions.md) **Sections 1 & 2**.

For each of the 6 layers:

1. Determine the source file path from the **Files Created** table.
2. Read the source file in full — extract **every public method signature** (name, parameters, return type).
3. Check whether a reference test file already exists at the test file path pattern (Section 1 table).
4. If it exists, read it in full and record which methods are already covered.
5. Compute the gap: `uncovered = all public methods − already covered methods`.

Produce a **Gap Analysis Summary** (shown in the lock file / progress):

```
Layer                  | Source methods | Already covered | To generate
-----------------------|---------------|-----------------|------------
API Controller         |             N |               N |           N
API Service            |             N |               N |           N
Repository             |             N |               N |           N
Web Controller         |             N |               N |           N
Web Service            |             N |               N |           N
Infrastructure Client  |             N |               N |           N
```

---

## Phase 2 — Test Generation

> 📄 Follow [06 — XUnit Test Generation](./../instructions/06-xunit-test-generation.instructions.md) **Sections 3–8** for all naming, patterns, scenarios, and `using` directives.

Work through each of the 6 layers **in order**. Complete each layer's test file before moving to the next.

### Layer ordering

1. **Repository** — deepest layer, no application dependencies
2. **API Service** — depends on repository interface
3. **API Controller** — depends on service interface
4. **Infrastructure API Client** — web infrastructure, no service dependency
5. **Web Application Service** — depends on API client interface
6. **Web MVC Controller** — topmost layer

### For each layer

- If **all methods already covered** → skip file creation; note in the output artefact.
- If **reference file exists** with partial coverage → add **only** the missing test methods to the existing file (do not overwrite covered tests).
- If **no reference file exists** → create a new test file containing tests for all public methods.
- Each test method name **must** follow `[MethodName]_[StateUnderTest]_[ExpectedResult]`.
- Each uncovered public method must have **at least** the minimum scenarios from Section 5 of the instructions.
- Group related tests in `#region [MethodName]` ... `#endregion` blocks (as per the existing reference file style).

---

## Phase 3 — Build Verification

> 📄 Follow [06 — XUnit Test Generation](./../instructions/06-xunit-test-generation.instructions.md) **Section 9**.

```powershell
# Run from: src/
dotnet build "Apha.FPS.All.sln" 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 8
```

Expected: `Build succeeded. 0 Error(s)`.

If the build fails:
1. Read the full error line (file path, line number, error code).
2. Fix the reported error.
3. Re-run the build command until 0 errors.
4. **Do not proceed to Phase 4 while any compile error remains.**

---

## Phase 4 — Publish Test Report & Archive Lock

> 📄 Follow [06 — XUnit Test Generation](./../instructions/06-xunit-test-generation.instructions.md) **Section 10** for the full report format.

1. Publish `zPostRunValidationArtefacts/[App]-[FormName]-Tests.md` with:
   - Coverage analysis table (all 6 layers)
   - Build issues table
   - Files Created / Modified table

2. Update the lock file — mark Phase 4 as **COMPLETED** (set Status = `COMPLETED`, set End timestamp) before archiving.

3. Archive the lock file:
   ```powershell
   Rename-Item `
     -Path  "zPostRunValidationArtefacts/.utagent-lock" `
     -NewName "utagentrun_$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss').log"

---

## Standards Applied Throughout

All generated test code must comply with:

> 📄 [04 — Code Standards, Naming Conventions & DataGrid Rules](./../instructions/04-standards-and-conventions.instructions.md)
>
> 📄 [07 — SonarCloud Fix Patterns](./../instructions/07-sonar-fix-patterns.instructions.md) — Sections 3 & 4 define the authoritative Sonar rule fix patterns; apply them to all generated test code.

Key rules specific to test code:

| Rule | Application to tests |
|---|---|
| **S1192** No magic strings | Use `private const string` for repeated string literals (IDs, codes) |
| **S1128** No unused `using` | Include only directives required by the generated test file |
| **S4462** Async all the way | All async test methods must be `async Task` — no `.Result` or `.Wait()` |
| **S1481** No unused locals | Every local variable must be used in at least one assertion or mock setup |
| **S109** No magic numbers | Use `private const int` for repeated numeric literals |
| **NSubstitute** | Use `Substitute.For<T>()` for all mocks except `DbContext` (use `RepositoryTestHelper`) |
| **Naming** | `[MethodName]_[StateUnderTest]_[ExpectedResult]` — strictly, no deviation |
| **Minimal** | Generate meaningful tests that cover logic, edge, and failure — not trivial property access |
| **Coverage** | Target ≥ 90% across all converted source files |
